## DefaultPlayerEntityController.localPredictionFastMovementByDefault property

Whether "fast" movement should be treated as the default owner intent.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get localPredictionFastMovementByDefault(): boolean;
```

## Remarks

Custom controllers sometimes expose `runByDefault` while still extending the stock controller. Treat that duck-typed flag as owner prediction input so the client can replay the same effective movement mode.
